mapper.insert: insert into member_info (user_id, rent_id, member_no, user_name, password, phone, image_url, current_level, total_points, create_time, update_time, deleted) values (#{userId}, #{rentId}, #{memberNo}, #{userName}, #{password}, #{phone}, #{imageUrl}, #{currentLevel}, #{totalPoints}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.select: select * from member_info where user_id = #{userId} and password = #{password} and rent_id = #{rentId}
